verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, a professional-services provider. Its client tools (Contract Generator, GDHQ, the D&O portal, Catalyze) are described only as web-based self-service portals, and ChatGD is an internal attorney chat app. Running the product headlessly or in a CI pipeline is a category error for this kind of offering, and no evidence shows it ships any such capability; the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
